name: Crypt wall section
description: A straight 1.5 m section of crypt wall, 0.6 m thick and 3 m high: cool, dark blue-grey dressed ashlar in regular staggered courses with worn rounded arrises over dark recessed joints, a slightly proud footing course and a plain coping on top. Damp darkens most of the footing blocks and runs down the faces in a few streaks under the joints.

provenance.prompt: A straight 1.5 m section of crypt wall: dark dressed ashlar, about 3 m high and 0.6 m thick. Cooler and darker than the village fieldstone, with worn joints and a little damp staining. The wall runs along x through the centre so sections join end to end.
